name: Dononter Minor
description: Dononter Minor was a world located in the Dononter Minor system, a part of the Mid Rim's Dononter sector. Dononter Minor had a Type I breathable atmosphere, and it was the homeworld of the plant known as the widowmaker, which could be used as a weapon.
